verdict.rationale: Docs thoroughly cover the core loop: ingest conversations/content (docs-1, docs-30, docs-37), store as memories (docs-10, docs-24), and retrieve via hybrid semantic search across memories/documents/graph/profile (docs-2, docs-23, docs-27, docs-15). GitHub README corroborates automatic fact extraction and profile-building across sessions (gh-4), and MCP tooling extends this across multiple client apps (docs-11, comm-3) for cross-session persistence. Missing for 10: independent quality/accuracy benchmarks for recall (only self-run MemoryBench is offered, docs-9/22) and one HN complaint about large-content ingestion failing (comm-1) shows an edge-case limitation not fully resolved in docs.
